newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Foreign investors push up Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investors push up Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: Foreign investor buying in hotel and banking stocks pushed up market index Semdex at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius on Monday, bourse officials said.
Semdex gained 3.54 points to 394.79 on transaction volume of 23.01 million rupees on 915,553 shares traded from 6.24 million rupees on 219,943 shares last Friday.
Brokers said a surge in Mauritius Commercial Bank and hotel concern Sun Resorts pushed up the bourse index.
MCB gained 1.50 rupees to 90 on 97,030 shares while State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 13 rupees on 569,540 shares.
"The two leading bank stocks, MCB and SBM accounted 70 percent of the total turnover on Monday," a broker said.
Insurance company Swan gained 20 cents to 46.30 rupees on 120 shares and British American Insurance (BAI) was stable at 8.45 rupees, but was not traded.
Sun Resorts rose 1.60 cents to 51 on 64,776 shares, New Mauritius Hotels climbed 30 cents to 37.30 on 3,000 shares and Grand Baie Hotel gained 50 cents to 46.50 on 200 shares.
In the commerce sector, Rogers lost a rupee to 105 on 1,800 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd gained 50 cents to 16.90 on 16,103 shares. Shell was stable at 20.50 rupees on 1,500 shares.
Sugar-based Mount lost 10 cents to 23.50 rupees on 2,000 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert fell 10 cents to 41.30 rupees on 50 shares.

Among Investment shares, United Docks was unchanged at 39 on 30,450 shares, Policy lost 15 cents to 4.15 on 8,700 shares, Mauritius Development and Investment Trust (MDIT) fell 10 cents to 7.70 on 27,100 shares and Promotion And Development eased 10 cents to 14.70 on 1,000 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius was a rupee higher at 42 on 19,210 shares.
